title: SM-16.01 - Why EUSurvey is focusing on EU institutional use
intent: This article answers: SM-16.01 - Why EUSurvey is focusing on EU institutional use
short_answer: EUSurvey is developed and maintained by the European Commission primarily to support EU Institutions, Bodies, Offices and Agencies. The transition supports long-term sustainability, EU governance, security, data protection compliance, and reliable support for institutional users.
important_conditions: This change does not prevent external users from responding to surveys.
External contractors may still manage surveys created under EU institutional responsibility when appropriate permissions are granted.
External users can still export data during the transition period.
